title: Minister's Private Office
purpose: Government sector card and executive-signing surfaces.
story: A minister's hands at the desk, pen poised over a blank document — the private instant in which authority is exercised.
environment: A minister's panelled private office, a heavy desk lit by a single lamp, the room beyond folded into shadow.
architecture: Implied only — dark wood panelling and a tall window suggested at the edge of the light.

people.notes: Only the hands and cuffs of a seated figure are visible at the desk; no face, no body above the wrists.

composition: Tight on the hands and pen over the desk blotter, warm light raking across the leather, the rest of the office in deep negative space.
objects: a blank document on a blotter
continuityNotes: Matches the set's near-black grade, single warm source, and brass-on-black palette of scene-01; the page must remain blank.
